ownerTodos: Send your booking link. Two places on this site are waiting for it, and a review already praises how easy booking is.
Send your prices, or say if you would rather not publish them.
Send photos: the shop front on Roosevelt, the chairs, and four or five finished cuts.
Confirm your barbers' names if you want the team listed by name.
If you have Instagram, send the handle. Google lists no social profile and none was found.
claimsAvoided: No years of experience. A review mentions Jovanni saying how long he has been barbering, but never says the number.
No redo or satisfaction guarantee. One review describes a cut being redone, which is one owner doing right by one customer, not a policy this site can promise on his behalf.
No barber named except Jovanni, and only because 'Jovanni The Barber' is part of the registered business name. A second barber is named once in a review and is not on the site.
No prices. Two reviews call it good value, which is an opinion about price, not a price.
No mention that one customer was initially unhappy with an associate's cut. The follow-up is the story; the complaint is not repeated.
No testimonials or review quotes. Review text is research, not copy.
No claim about the booking system beyond that one exists, since no source says which one.
